      <p class="bio-lede">I am a Lecturer at the School of Cybernetics, Australian National University (ANU), in Canberra, Australia.</p>
      <p>With a background in mathematics and physics, I approach questions of self-organisation and complexity through both mathematical and transdisciplinary perspectives. My research began with geometry-driven hyperuniformity and has since expanded towards the structures and dynamics of information systems, including interactions involving generative AI.</p>
      <p>Across research and education, I am interested in how seemingly different systems can reveal common principles of emergence, feedback, adaptation, and collective behaviour.</p>
